sources.title: IQR-V4: Measured Widths, a Vocabulary-Weighted Head and Faster Kernels
sources.snippet: Abstract IQR-V4 is the fourth format of the IQR series for Qwen3.8-27B on AMD R9700 cards. It keeps V3’s computed trellis code and its one f32 scale a row, and changes where the bits go and how the kernels read them.
